messages:
maria: quick Q — opened PR #4521 that updates CODEOWNERS to add /services/edge-router and tweaks infra/ci. who can approve? current file points infra stuff to @eng-infra and services to @eng-runtime. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4521
noah: pinging @samuel for runtime review and @oliver for infra — looks like two owner groups involved
samuel: I can take runtime. quick heads-up: owner-check flagged infra/ci as owned by eng-infra, so we'll need eng-infra approval for that path too
maria: ugh okay — I added infra/ci because of a small CI config change. should I split into two PRs or keep together? would rather not split to avoid extra rollouts
infra-bot: CODEOWNERS_CHECK: paths matched -> `services/edge-router` -> eng-runtime (required), `infra/ci` -> eng-infra (required)
oliver: I can approve the infra/ci change, but want a short comment in the PR explaining why CI tweak is grouped with service owner change. @eng-infra FYI
samuel: looked through runtime diff, left one tiny nit (naming), otherwise LGTM — will approve after that fix
maria: addressed the nit and added a one-paragraph justification in the PR description explaining why both changes are in one PR (avoid double deploy + atomic config). CI re-ran and is green
noah: perfect. once both runtime and infra approvals are present i'll do the merge and cut the canary. maria — can you please add one line to the changelog about edge-router owner change?
maria: done — added changelog line. thanks! :raised_hands:
noah: :thumbsup: i see both approvals and CI green; merging in 5 unless anyone objects
samuel: no objections
oliver: go for it
noah: merged and triggered canary deploy — watch the runbooks and @eng-oncall if anything odd shows up
maria: thanks all, appreciate the quick help
